verdict.rationale: A state corporation registry could plausibly publish bulk registry extracts, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: both www.scc.virginia.gov and cis.scc.virginia.gov disallow all crawling, so no content was fetched and no bulk download or data extract was found. Confidence is low because this verdict reflects absence of evidence from an unexamined site, not a confirmed lack of the capability.
